tagline: Two open sessions, one file: ask before the second edit lands

features.title: Shared log
features.detail: Each session records the files it edits, with its prompt number, in its own small file under ~/.claude/mods-data/mod-collision-guard/sessions, so sessions never write over each other.

features.title: Pause
features.detail: Before Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit, a card above the prompt holds the call when another open session edited that file inside the window. It names that session (its /rename title, else a short id), its prompt number and when it edited, with the file as a link that opens in VS Code.

features.title: Four ways out
features.detail: Type 1, 2 or 3 in the empty prompt, or click: Cancel (asks why, Enter alone skips), move to a worktree (Claude calls EnterWorktree and redoes the edit there, offered only inside a git repo), or proceed. If the check itself fails, the same card offers Cancel and Proceed.
